tsa-a12-v01.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v01.question: Why is the bath taught before initiation?
premises: Initiation and the rest must be told — it is said.
To expound the nature of initiation, first the to-be-done bath is taught.
tsa-a12-v01.inference: The bath is the precondition of the exposition: initiation's nature is set forth by first teaching the bath to be performed.

tsa-a12-v02.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v02.question: What is bathing called, and what is it?
premises: Bathing is called purity.
Purity is immersion in the Supreme Lord's own form.
tsa-a12-v02.inference: Snāna is defined twice over: named purity, and purity itself is samāveśa in the Lord's own svarūpa — water-rite and identity-collapse are one word.

tsa-a12-v03.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v03.question: What counts as turbidity, and what washes it?
premises: Washing off turbidity is indeed purity.
Turbidity — even in That whose sole form is That — is the conceit of admixing another form of alien nature.
tsa-a12-v03.inference: Impurity is not dirt but abhimāna: the conceit of a second, alien form inside the sole-formed That; its removal alone is śuddhi.

tsa-a12-v04.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v04.question: Where does the admixing-conceit arise, and how is it dispelled?
premises: Here, in the self whose essence is free-bliss-consciousness-alone — or everywhere in the world too — the conceit of admixing another-formed reality is impurity.
That is dispelled by immersion in great-Bhairava: for someone suddenly, for someone else awaiting further means.
tsa-a12-v04.inference: The conceit defiles self or world alike; mahābhairava-samāveśa removes it — jhaṭiti for the ripe, upāyāntara-prekṣin for the rest.

tsa-a12-v05.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v05.question: How manifold is difference?
premises: Therein too, by one-two-threefold division, whole or part-wise, somewhere, for someone, sometime.
And so from assurance-attainment: difference is manifold.
tsa-a12-v05.inference: Bheda is vicitra by construction: division-grade, extent, locus, person, time all vary, and the manifoldness itself proceeds from assurance-attainment (āśvāsa-upalabdhi).

tsa-a12-v06.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v06.question: What is the eightfold bath, and what does it yield?
premises: Eightfold, in earth-water-wind-fire-sky-moon-sun-self forms, made into Supreme-Lord forms by mantra-placing majesty; by identity, in the Lord-entered body, immersion in the Supreme arises for anyone.
Though from bathing-clothes-and-so-on gladness it becomes the means to the Supreme — thus told.
Chief fruits therein: firmness, nourishment, vigor, impurity-burning, pervasion, creation-capacity, maintenance-capacity, non-difference.
tsa-a12-v06.inference: The eight mūrti-baths work by tādātmya in the Lord-entered body; their gladness itself becomes upāyātā; the mantra's assumed each-form yields the eight chief fruits.

tsa-a12-v07.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v07.question: What is the heroes' distinction in bathing?
premises: By heroes-rule the distinction: as battle-dust, hero-water, great wind, hero-ash, cremation-ground-sky.
Sun-and-moon placed in them, self undiscriminating.
tsa-a12-v07.inference: Vīroddeśa's five hero-substances with candrārkau placed are the warrior-grade bath; the ātman there is nirvikalpaka — undiscriminating.

tsa-a12-v08.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v08.question: What is the outer-inner twoness of the plunge?
premises: Again too, as outer-inner twoness, by oneness with the outward-worshipped mantra, made-of-That.
There, there plunging — thus told.
tsa-a12-v08.inference: The twoness of bāhya/ābhyantara is collapsed by mantra-tādātmya: made-of-That, the plunge here-there is pronounced and closed.

tsa-a12-v09.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v09.question: What is the chief bath?
premises: But bliss-substance, hero-abiding, by looking, having-made-Śiva: right-there mantra-circle-worship.
Thence by that very one, body-and-breath deity-circle satisfied — thus the chief bath.
tsa-a12-v09.inference: The mukhya-snāna: ānanda-dravya seen in vīra-ādhāra and made Śiva, mantra-cakra pūjā, then tarpaṇa of the deity-circle abiding in body and breath.

tsa-a12-v10.speaker: Teacher (snāna-prakāśana)
tsa-a12-v10.question: What is the inward bath?
premises: Inward, thus, by holding earth-and-so-on-formed forms — here, there, in earthen-and-rest circles.
Being-made-of-That.
tsa-a12-v10.inference: The ābhyantara bath is dhāraṇā of the same forms in pārthiva-cakra circles — the identity clause (tanmayībhāvaḥ) closes the āhnika.

essence: Initiation's nature is set forth through the bath: the to-be-done bath is taught first.
Bathing names purity; purity is immersion in the Supreme Lord's own form.
Purity is washing-off of turbidity; turbidity is the conceit of admixing an alien form — even in That whose sole form is That.
The conceit of another-formed reality is impurity in self or world alike; dispelled by great-Bhairava immersion — sudden for some, for others awaiting further means.
Difference is manifold — by one-two-threefold division, whole or part, somewhere, for someone, sometime, from assurance-attainment.

Eight forms made into Supreme-Lord forms by mantra-placement: identity in the Lord-entered body brings immersion for anyone; bathing-gladness itself becomes the means; chief fruits — firmness to non-difference — follow each assumed form.
Heroes-rule sets the five substances — battle-dust to cremation-ground sky — with sun-moon placed and the self undiscriminating.
Outer-inner twoness collapses by oneness with the outward-worshipped mantra: made-of-That, plunging here-there, thus told.
The chief bath: bliss-substance hero-abiding made-Śiva, mantra-circle worshipped, deity-circle of body-and-breath satisfied by that very one.
The inward bath holds earth-and-other forms in earthen circles — being-made-of-That.

rasa.dominant: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)
rasa.sthayibhava: śama with vidhi (quiescence as ordered rite)
rasa.justification: The rite is named, not dramatized: definition, grades, fruits, close — each stated in order. Relish is settled procedure; wonder enters only as the eight forms and their fruits.

sections.SUMMARY: The exposition opens with the bath: to set forth initiation's nature, the to-be-done bath is taught first. Bathing names purity; purity is immersion in the Supreme Lord's own form. Purity is washing-off of turbidity; turbidity is the conceit of admixing an alien form — even in That whose sole form is That. The conceit of another-formed reality is impurity in self or world alike; dispelled by great-Bhairava immersion — sudden for some, for others awaiting further means. Difference is manifold — by one-two-threefold division, whole or part, somewhere, for someone, sometime, from assurance-attainment. Eight forms made into Supreme-Lord forms by mantra-placement: identity in the Lord-entered body brings immersion for anyone; bathing-gladness itself becomes the means; chief fruits — firmness to non-difference — follow each assumed form. Heroes-rule sets the five substances — battle-dust to cremation-ground sky — with sun-moon placed and the self undiscriminating. Outer-inner twoness collapses by oneness with the outward-worshipped mantra: made-of-That, plunging here-there, thus told. The chief bath: bliss-substance hero-abiding made-Śiva, mantra-circle worshipped, deity-circle of body-and-breath satisfied by that very one. The inward bath holds earth-and-other forms in earthen circles — being-made-of-That.
sections.FUNCTION: Defines bath-as-immersion, grades it (worldwide impurity, eight mūrti forms, heroes' substances, chief bath, inward hold), and closes on made-of-That.
sections.KEY TERMS: snāna (bath as purity); śuddhi (turbidity-washing); abhimāna (alien-form conceit); mahābhairava-samāveśa (dispelling immersion); tādātmya (identity in the Lord-entered body); vīroddeśa (heroes' five substances); mukhya-snāna (chief bath); tanmayībhāva (made-of-That close).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The bath is taught as the precondition of dīkṣā-vidhi; eightfold, heroes', chief, and inward forms graded in turn before the initiation-rite the bath serves.
sections.BOUNDARY: No cosmology argued: the rite's definition, grades, and fruits are stated; the fruits-list stands as authority, not as proof.
sections.EXPLANATION: Because snāna is samāveśa, impurity must be abhimāna rather than dirt; because the conceit can arise in self or world, the dispelling immersion is universal in scope yet graded in time (jhaṭiti for some, upāyāntara-prekṣin for others); because identity does the work, the eight forms need only mantra-placement in the Lord-entered body, and the gladness of the rite itself becomes the means — hence the chief fruits and the inward hold: same forms, circles of earth, made-of-That.
sections.RELATED: Pradipaka ch.12 (same text, pada-glossed); Vishvasa ch.12 (translation); Chakravarty on snāna as absorption — lore support, never witness; qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.

the cremation-ground sky — sun and moon placed in them,
the self undiscriminating.
tsa-a12-v07.sanskrit_cite: vīroddeśena tu viśeṣaḥ tad yathā raṇareṇuḥ vīrāmbhaḥ mahāmarut vīrabhasma śmaśānanabhaḥ tadupahitau candrārkau ātmā nirvikalpakaḥ

lines: Again too, as outer-inner twoness:
by oneness with the outward-worshipped mantra,
made of That — plunging here, there: thus told.
tsa-a12-v08.sanskrit_cite: punar api bāhyābhyantaratayā dvitvam bahirupāsyamantratādātmyena tanmayīkṛte tatra tatra nimajjanam ity uktam

lines: But the bliss-substance, abiding as the hero's support,
by looking, having made it Śiva — right there,
the mantra-circle's worship; thence by that very one,
body-and-breath deity-circle satisfied: thus the chief bath.
tsa-a12-v09.sanskrit_cite: viśeṣas tu ānandadravyaṃ vīrādhāragataṃ nirīkṣaṇena śivamayīkṛtya tatraiva mantracakrapūjanam tataḥ tenaiva dehaprāṇobhayāśritadevatācakratarpaṇam iti mukhyaṃ snānam

lines: Inward, thus: by holding earth-and-other-formed forms —
here, there, in the earthen and other circles —
the state of being made of That.
tsa-a12-v10.sanskrit_cite: ābhyantaraṃ yathā tattaddharādirūpadhāraṇayā tatra tatra pārthivādau cakre tanmayībhāvaḥ

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: ordered precondition — the vidhi opens by declaring its own order (FIRST unit: sets the house voice; owner verdict required). Sanskrit-first: vaktavyam gerundive kept passive (must-be-told); prāk + kartavyam order kept: nature-set-forth AFTER bath-taught. Rows: 1 (first…taught: the instruction's sequence IS the line-break), 6 (iti-uktaṃ 'it is said' anchors the declaration verbatim), 12 (śānta-close: the bath lands, nothing yet performed). Close: 'the to-be-done bath is taught.' Rejected: opening with the bath — killed: prāk order is the argument; 'shall be expounded' for told — killed: vaktavyam kept must-be-told. Read aloud: IN-i-ti-a-TION and-the-REST must-be-TOLD — it-is-SAID; SO-to-SET-forth IN-i-ti-a-TION's NA-ture, FIRST the-TO-be-DONE BATH is-TAUGHT.

reads_against.argmap: Why is the bath taught before initiation? → The bath is the precondition of the exposition: initiation's nature is set forth by first teaching the bath to be performed.
c1_essence: Initiation's nature is set forth through the bath: the to-be-done bath is taught first.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: definition — two names, one substance. Sanskrit-first: ca twice (bathing-AND-purity linked, not equalled); samāveśaḥ nom. pred: purity IS immersion. Rows: 9 (name→substance pair), 1 ('own form' closes — svarūpa end-weight), 12 (definition settles, no performance yet). Close: 'entering the Supreme Lord's own form.' Rejected: quoting L2's 'immersion' sentence — killed: zero-shared-L2 rule (reworded to saṃviṣ 'entering'); 'baptism' — killed: snāna kept bath. Read aloud: BATH-ing IS-called PU-ri-ty — AND-pu-ri-TY is-EN-ter-ing THE-SU-preme-LORD's OWN-form.

reads_against.argmap: What is bathing called, and what is it? → Snāna is defined twice over: named purity, and purity itself is samāveśa in the Lord's own svarūpa — water-rite and identity-collapse are one word.
c1_essence: Bathing names purity; purity is immersion in the Supreme Lord's own form.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: turbidity-as-conceit — the rite's target named. Sanskrit-first: hi emphatic kept ('that indeed'); tadekarūpe 'pi concessive kept ('even in That'); abhimāna = conceit, not dirt (C1 crux). Rows: 9 (purity/turbidity antithesis doubled), 1 ('alien nature' closes — the other-form named last), 10 (conceit left standing, no image added). Close: 'is the conceit of admixing a form of alien nature.' Rejected: 'delusion' for conceit — killed: abhimāna is self-conceit, not moha; 'even in the One' — killed: tadekarūpe kept That-whose-form. Read aloud: WASH-ing-OFF-turb-ID-ity — THAT in-DEED is-PU-ri-ty; AND-turb-ID-i-ty, EV-en IN-That WHOSE sole-FORM is-THAT, IS the-CON-CEIT of-AD-mix-ing a-FORM of-A-li-en-NA-ture.

reads_against.argmap: What counts as turbidity, and what washes it? → Impurity is not dirt but abhimāna: the conceit of a second, alien form inside the sole-formed That; its removal alone is śuddhi.
c1_essence: Purity is washing-off of turbidity; turbidity is the conceit of admixing an alien form — even in That whose sole form is That.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: dispelling graded — universal scope, timed release. Sanskrit-first: sā ca (that-too) kept; jhaṭiti + upāyāntara-prekṣiṇ contrast kept as two destinies (sudden / awaiting). Rows: 5 (long-sweep processional: self-or-world, then dispelling, then the two grades), 9 (suddenly-for-some / awaiting-for-others pair), 1 (‘further means’ closes — the not-yet kept open). Close: 'suddenly for some — for others awaiting further means.' Rejected: resolving the two grades into one — killed: kasyacid/kasyāpi split is the grading; ‘instantly’ for jhaṭiti alone — killed: the pair must stand. Read aloud: HERE — IN the-SELF whose-PITH is-FREE-BLISS, CON-scious-ness a-LONE, OR-ev-ery-WHERE IN the-WORLD as-WELL — THE-con-CEIT of-AD-mix-ING a-noth-er-FORMED re-AL-i-TY is-IM-pu-Ri-ty; THAT, too, is-WASHED-OUT BY-great-BHAI-ra-va-IM-mer-SION: SUDD-en-ly FOR-SOME — FOR-OTH-ers A-wait-ing fur-THER-means.

reads_against.argmap: Where does the admixing-conceit arise, and how is it dispelled? → The conceit defiles self or world alike; mahābhairava-samāveśa removes it — jhaṭiti for the ripe, upāyāntara-prekṣin for the rest.
c1_essence: The conceit of another-formed reality is impurity in self or world alike; dispelled by great-Bhairava immersion — sudden for some, for others awaiting further means.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: manifold-difference — the multiplicity clause. Sanskrit-first: kutra/kadā/kasya indefinites kept bare (somewhere/someone/sometime); āśvāsa-upalabdhi kept as source-ablative ('from assurance-attainment'). Rows: 9 (one-two-threefold + whole/part + somewhere/someone/sometime triple-triple), 5 (graded roll: division, extent, the three indefinites, then the source), 1 (‘manifold’ closes — vicitra end-weight). Close: 'difference is manifold.' Rejected: 'various' — killed: vicitra is manifold-of-differences (bheda-adjacent); dropping the indefinites for rhythm — killed: the three bare words ARE the manifoldness. Read aloud: THERE-in-TOO — BY-one-, TWO-, THREE-fold-DI-vi-SION, WHOLE or-PART; SOME-where, FOR-SOME-one, SOME-time, AND-so FROM-AS-surance-AT-tain-ment: DIFF-er-ence IS-man-i-FOLD.

reads_against.argmap: How manifold is difference? → Bheda is vicitra by construction: division-grade, extent, locus, person, time all vary, and the manifoldness itself proceeds from assurance-attainment (āśvāsa-upalabdhi).
c1_essence: Difference is manifold — by one-two-threefold division, whole or part, somewhere, for someone, sometime, from assurance-attainment.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: eightfold machinery — the catalogue that does the work. Sanskrit-first: aṣṭadhā + the eight-form list kept item-wise; tādātmyena ca (by-identity-too) kept the hinge; etīti/uktaṃ kept the verdict-voice; fruit-list kept all eight (each fruit a claim, none trimmed). Rows: 9 (eight forms + eight fruits — double catalogue), 2 (long compound lists unpacked down the line-break), 1 (‘assuming that and that form’ closes — tattadrūpa end-weight), 12 declined — the catalogue's roll is the energy, not settle. Close: 'assuming that and that form.' Rejected: trimming the fruit-list to four — killed: eight are the claim (firmness-to-nondifference); resolving 'śrīmadānandādau' — killed: held as glossed, noted in L3 (person-or-joy locus unresolved); 'deities' for forms — killed: mūrti kept forms. Read aloud: AND-EIGHT-fold: IN-earth-, WA-ter-, WIND-, FIRE-, SKY-, MOON-, SUN-, AND-self-FORMED-places … CHIEF-fruits, HERE-and-THERE, FROM-the-MAN-tra PLACED-in-EACH, AS-SUM-ing THAT-and-THAT-form.

reads_against.argmap: What is the eightfold bath, and what does it yield? → The eight mūrti-baths work by tādātmya in the Lord-entered body; their gladness itself becomes upāyātā; the mantra's assumed each-form yields the eight chief fruits.
c1_essence: Eight forms made into Supreme-Lord forms by mantra-placement: identity in the Lord-entered body brings immersion for anyone; bathing-gladness itself becomes the means; chief fruits — firmness to non-difference — follow each assumed form.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: heroes' rule — warrior-grade distinction. Sanskrit-first: vīroddeśena tu (by-heroes-rule-but) kept; five substances listed whole (raṇareṇu→śmaśānanabhaḥ); candrārkau du. kept sun-and-moon; nirvikalpakaḥ closes. reads_against.argmap: What is the heroes' distinction in bathing? → Vīroddeśa's five hero-substances with candrārkau placed are the warrior-grade bath; the ātman there is nirvikalpaka — undiscriminating.
c1_essence: Heroes-rule sets the five substances — battle-dust to cremation-ground sky — with sun-moon placed and the self undiscriminating.

Rejected: 'immersion' for nimajjanam — killed: ni-√majj is plunge, distinct from samāveśa used earlier; 'made by That' — killed: tanmayīkṛta is made-OF-That (identity, not agency). reads_against.argmap: What is the outer-inner twoness of the plunge? → The twoness of bāhya/ābhyantara is collapsed by mantra-tādātmya: made-of-That, the plunge here-there is pronounced and closed.
c1_essence: Outer-inner twoness collapses by oneness with the outward-worshipped mantra: made-of-That, plunging here-there, thus told.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: the chief bath — the rite's summit. Rows: 9 (worship→satisfaction→chief-bath triple verdict), 1 (‘chief bath’ closes — mukhya-snāna named last), 6 (iti verdict-voice). Close: 'thus the chief bath.' Rejected: ‘bliss-essence’ — killed: dravya is substance (thing, not quality); ‘by it’ — killed: tenaiva is by-that-very-one (the worship itself acts). Read aloud: BUT the-BLISS-sub-STANCE, a-BID-ing AS the-HER-o's-SUP-port, BY-look-ing, HAV-ing-MADE-it ŚI-va — RIGHT-there, THE-man-tra-CIR-CLE's-WOR-ship; THENCE BY-that-VER-y-ONE, BODY-and-BREATH-de-i-ty-CIR-CLE SAT-is-fied: THUS-the-CHIEF-bath.

reads_against.argmap: What is the chief bath? → The mukhya-snāna: ānanda-dravya seen in vīra-ādhāra and made Śiva, mantra-cakra pūjā, then tarpaṇa of the deity-circle abiding in body and breath.
c1_essence: The chief bath: bliss-substance hero-abiding made-Śiva, mantra-circle worshipped, deity-circle of body-and-breath satisfied by that very one.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying ritual order)
